2609.20565.title: Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies
2609.20565.paper_summary: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT.
2609.20565.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型方面的進展徹底改變了心理諮詢領域，特別是在認知行為療法（CBT）的背景下。雖然CBT的成功在很大程度上依賴於根據客戶的即時心理狀態進行的動態決策，但這一方面在當前研究中經常被忽視，限制了靈活性和治療效果。在本文中，我們介紹了StratCBT，一個專門為心理諮詢對話設計的數據集，包含CBT策略，共有9,688個會話和約256K的話語，每位諮詢師的回應都與八種不同策略之一對齊。StratCBT的創建涉及根據客戶的負面思想建模，並通過自我對話生成高質量的諮詢對話，融入現實的會話作為指導，從而在一般諮詢和CBT特定技能方面顯著超越現有數據集。我們進行了廣泛的實驗，以展示策略對齊生成的有效性，並評估其在提供專業和有效的諮詢方面的功效，使用LLM模擬的客戶以反映現實場景。該數據集可以從https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT獲得。
